title: Second Brain vocabulary
description: Reusable JSON Schema definitions for note, source, and workflow vocabulary.

id.description: A globally unique lowercase ASCII kebab-case identifier.

type.description: The primary content type of a note.

status.description: The lifecycle state of a note.

tag.description: An allowed flat, lowercase repository tag.

aiAuthor.description: A namespaced AI identity, optionally including a version.

author.description: A namespaced human or AI identity.

dateTime.description: An ISO 8601 date-time with an explicit UTC designator or numeric timezone offset.

sourceUrl.description: A public HTTP or HTTPS source URL.

sourceLocation.description: A repository-relative POSIX path inside a dedicated source-cache directory.

sha256.description: An optional SHA-256 checksum represented as 64 hexadecimal characters.
